title: Reco.ai -- AI-Powered Finance Reconciliation
description: Built a three-layer reconciliation engine (deterministic rules -> LLM classification -> human approval) that auto-matched 50% of a 100-case batch instantly, with the AI layer classifying the remaining 50% into actionable exception categories backed by Pydantic-validated evidence and an append-only human-review audit trail. Measured five evaluation metrics against isolated ground truth with 98 CI-safe unit tests.
